title: X25519 ECDH handshake over a unix socket with HKDF key derivation
summary: Two processes perform an X25519 key exchange over a local socket, derive symmetric keys via HKDF-SHA256, and exchange one authenticated message under the derived key. No certificate trust — assume the sockets are local.
deliverables: Two binaries (initiator + responder) that complete the handshake
Derived key passes a known-answer test against an HKDF reference vector
Authenticated message decrypts correctly on the receiver
